scope: Real GPU EngineCore execution, local IPC receipt times, no HTTP or network emulation. TTFT includes queueing and prefill; TPOT excludes first-token wait. Only complete outputs enter latency comparisons. Medians across three engine launches, after within-launch medians of two requests per shape for mixed batches; descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals. XeoVerse supplies orbital timing; the 30/50/100 ms compute allowances are assumptions.
